status_meaning: Evidence integrity only; physical and strict/configured convergence verdicts remain separate.

cases.title: 有界 PD：200 与 1000 次迭代预算
cases.observation: 两设置均通过冻结的物理门槛；200→1000 次迭代后，原严格三容差 1e-7 下收敛比例仍为 0%；终止残差及 body/joint 轨迹逐元素相同，r_c 中位数 4.25416e-07 J。预定六个时间步的尾20次有界行 x/y/z 均不再变化，支持持续停滞而非仅200次预算不足。
cases.limitations: 仅固定的CPU单转子饱和场景，物理门槛通过不代表严格收敛通过；未证明普适float32精度下限，没有改求解器实现；每迭代观测同步开销不支持性能排名。
cases.association_scope: 相同物理初态和驱动，直接单因素比较 config.padmm.max_iterations；严格 baseline 在四个配对页复用，两次独立重复按唯一run计数。

cases.limitations: 仅固定的CPU单转子饱和场景，物理门槛通过不代表严格收敛通过；未证明普适float32精度下限，没有改求解器实现；每迭代观测同步开销不支持性能排名。

cases.title: 非饱和隐式PD：正负位置目标与中途反向
cases.observation: 正负目标在2s反向，四次运行最大离散参考角误差 1.62892e-07 rad；物理验收 passed。收敛比例范围 100.000%–100.000%，不能从物理吻合推断逐步求解收敛。
cases.limitations: Newton1.7.0 pinned commit only, CPU singleworld dense PADMM; No contacts/gravity/armature/friction or translation eccentricity; Only bounded implicit PD interior; saturation and runtime limit changes belong to separate experiments; Private state/config reads are observational instrumentation, not supported user API; Single critically damped gain setting and fixed dt, not universal PD tuning; Mirror comparison is symmetry evidence; scalar recurrence supplies independent correctness evidence; Strict solver termination is diagnosed separately; physical pass does not imply every step converged.
cases.association_scope: 直接测量固定增益/有限力限下的非饱和跟踪机制及target-mode语义；未逐参数扫描kp/kd/力限，不外推任意频率、带宽或步长。

cases.title: 动态目标与速度参考语义：POSITION_VELOCITY 对 POSITION
cases.observation: 同传位置/速度正弦参考，POSITION_VELOCITY 与 POSITION 末周期 RMS 为 0.0193778/0.0664529 rad，前者改善 70.84%；物理验收 passed。POSITION 按实现忽略速度参考而保留阻尼。收敛比例范围 100.000%–100.000%。
cases.limitations: Newton1.7.0 pinned commit only, CPU singleworld dense PADMM; No contacts/gravity/armature/friction or translation eccentricity; Only bounded implicit PD interior; saturation and runtime limit changes belong to separate experiments; Private state/config reads are observational instrumentation, not supported user API; One smooth frequency/amplitude only; no claim of arbitrary-bandwidth tracking; Comparison tests target-mode semantics, not solver backend ranking; Strict solver termination is diagnosed separately; physical pass does not imply every step converged.
cases.association_scope: 直接测量固定增益/有限力限下的非饱和跟踪机制及target-mode语义；未逐参数扫描kp/kd/力限，不外推任意频率、带宽或步长。

cases.title: 有界隐式 PD：有限正力限切换、释放与重新饱和
cases.observation: 已按公开通知契约完成正反力限切换，全部预设物理门槛通过。物理门槛与严格 PADMM 收敛诊断分开记录。 最大力矩参考误差 2.66e-06 N·m；A 每次切换在同一步采用新限值，状态在通知前后不跳变；A/B 收敛标记比例 100%/100%，仅适用于本小驱动场景，不覆盖旧高增益场景。
cases.limitations: One finite-positive limit update contract on one CPU Y hinge, no route topology change, no zero/inf/sentinel, no unnotified update, no gain/mode change, contacts, GPU, graph capture, multiworld or general convergence claim. Strict convergence statistics are diagnostics and may fail even if physical gates pass.
cases.association_scope: Only finite positive effort limit is varied via public notify; gains, mode, solver budget and timestep fixed. No zero/infinite or route-allocation change coverage.
